shots.note: hook / cover: finished tsar-nail (царь-ноготь) close-up, AB crystals flash blue and orange as the hand turns; no subtitles on screen
line 0 (покрыли топом, материал замазал грани): brush loaded with wet base worked in among the big crystals on the black nail
line 1 (только по торцам): thin brush runs base along the side edge of the tsar-nail, not over the stones
line 1 (и в промежутках): brush goes into the gaps between the stones of the black applique, not on top of them
placing: wax pencil sets crystals into the base at the cuticle end of the silver nail (end of line 1 / start of line 2)
line 2 (крупные стразы не на кончик): wax pencil sets a large AB stone mid-nail on the black nail, well away from the tip
line 2 (кончик - самое уязвимое место): big stones sit at the base, wax pencil brings only a small stone to the silver tip; no subtitles, so the crop goes lower to keep the tip above the caption
line 3 (царь-ноготь, который держится и блестит): finished tsar-nail beside the black applique, hand tilts, crystals sparkle; no subtitles on screen
END (under the CTA): finished crystal set on the hand (blue line, tsar-nail, black applique, french), calm slight turn; nails in the upper 70%; no subtitles on screen; earlier moment than r01 e1-set
